name: Blog Post Writing
description: Writes complete blog posts with title, introduction hook, H2-structured body sections, and a closing call-to-action. Use when the user asks to write a blog post, draft a blog article, create website content, or compose an online article. Do NOT use for SEO-optimized posts (use `seo-blog-post`), listicles (use `listicle-writing`), how-to tutorials (use `how-to-guide`), or opinion/editorial pieces (use `opinion-piece`).
